name: Convert Pial (Cortical) and White Matter Surfaces from Freesurfer
summary: Converts FreeSurfer pial, white, smoothwm and inflated surfaces of both hemispheres to VTK, STL, GIFTI or MGZ meshes with mris_convert.
description: Utility that runs FreeSurfer mris_convert on the eight lh/rh pial, white, smoothwm and inflated surfaces of a FreeSurfer subject and writes them in the chosen file format. Use it to get cortical surface meshes for visualisation or for tools that do not read FreeSurfer surface files. Needs a complete FreeSurfer output; the App fails if any of the eight surfaces is not produced.

outputs.description: Folder with eight meshes: lh/rh.pial, lh/rh.white, lh/rh.smoothwm and lh/rh.inflated in the chosen format.

parameters.description: Output file format (extension) for the converted surfaces: vtk, stl, gii or mgz.

citations.text: Avesani P. et al. The open diffusion data derivatives, brain data upcycling via integrated publishing of derivatives and reproducible open cloud services. Sci Data 6, 69 (2019).

failure_modes.cause: Fewer than eight converted surfaces were written.
failure_modes.fix: Check that the FreeSurfer input contains all pial, white, smoothwm and inflated surfaces.
Set FREESURFER_LICENSE on the compute resource.
